title: A Psalm for the Wild-Built
author: Becky Chambers
summary: A tea monk who is tired of his job leaves the city to travel the countryside and finds a robot that has come out of the wilderness for the first time in generations. The two embark on a gentle trip while the robot asks what people actually need.
readIf: you want a short, calming read about purpose, rest and an unexpected friendship.
skipIf: you want plot and conflict, since very little happens and the book is meant to be soothing.

pairings.reason: Another cosy, low-conflict story about a person changing their life by slowing down.
Same author, a warmer ensemble space road-trip with more characters and more adventure.
Another gentle story about a robot's view of humans, though quieter and more melancholic.
